== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A soul-oath is a [[binding]] vow made upon an individual's [[spirit]]. These oaths function as a [[technique]] to establish trust, ensure loyalty, or formalize commitments between parties. The strength and [[binding]] nature of an oath are directly tied to the power of the souls involved; more powerful spirits create much more significant and serious obligations. While traditional wisdom suggests these vows cannot be coerced, it is possible to create weaker but still [[binding]] oaths through compulsion. Violating a soul-oath carries severe consequences, though the exact nature of these punishments is often shrouded in rumor. The severity of the penalty appears to [[scale]] with the practitioner's power level, potentially resulting in damage to one's core or even crippling a person's future potential. Oaths can be mutual, creating a shared bond between two people, or one-sided, which possesses less [[binding]] force. Some specialized tools, such as the [[Grand Oath Array]], may also be used in relation to these vows.}}
